versions.changelog:
Initial release: Launch of the Agentic AI Coat Designer for generating custom coat designs.

- Instantly generate customized coat designs for Print on Demand (POD) and Manufacturing on Demand (MOD).
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text, logo placement, and interactive 3D viewers.
- Multi-view design sheet and 3D design asset generation included.
- API for generating design drafts from natural-language prompts, images, and clothing templates.
- Seamless integration with the Craftsman Agent Manufacturing Platform for supplier matching.
